title: Starbie
tagline: A motion-controlled desktop pet on a custom PCB.
built: A tiny motion-controlled digital pet, basically a desktop Tamagotchi, on a custom PCB around the XIAO ESP32-C3. It detects movement with an MPU6050, reads temperature and humidity with a DHT11, shows info on an OLED, gives feedback with an RGB LED, and takes input from Cherry MX switches. Schematic and PCB designed in KiCad for Hack Club's HalfLife, following their Week 1 PCB tutorial.
learned: My second hardware project, so I pushed for something more interesting than the first one, and HalfLife gave me a reason to actually design, build and document it instead of leaving it as an idea.

title: DevRuler
tagline: A custom PCB ruler for developers, with hardware footprints, everyday commands, and SI unit conversions.
built: An everyday ruler made for developers, designed from scratch in KiCad and made with JLCPCB. It packs hardware footprints for quick sizing, everyday commands for when your brain blanks, basic SI unit conversions, and Hack Club and Forge branding.
learned: I got hooked on the idea after seeing a PCB ruler in a hardware video, found Hack Club's hardware-only program Forge, and designed the whole board myself.

title: Pocket Gravity Lab
tagline: A portable physics lab for exploring gravity and orbital mechanics through real-time simulations and physical controls.
built: Just getting started. The goal is a portable, interactive physics lab for exploring gravity and orbital mechanics: real-time simulations, physical controls, and embedded hardware, written in C++ for the Teensy 4.1.

title: Marbew
tagline: A custom 3D-printed marble race, designed from scratch.
built: A custom 3D-printed marble race, designed from scratch. In progress.

title: Obsidian
tagline: An obsidian-themed keyboard project. Planned, not started yet.
built: An obsidian-themed custom mechanical keyboard. Planned, not started yet.

title: Sound Galaxy
tagline: Turns microphone input into a moving galaxy of particles in real time.
built: Turns microphone input into a moving galaxy of particles in real time. Turn on your mic, play music, or shout, and the galaxy reacts. Built by following Hack Club's Sound Galaxy workshop.
learned: Built to level up my programming and explore what modern web tools can do creatively.

title: Particle Physics
tagline: A gravity simulation where particles pull on each other like tiny planets.
built: A gravity simulation in p5.js where every particle pulls on every other one based on mass and distance, so they sling each other around and form little chaotic solar systems in the browser. Built by following Hack Club's Particle Physics workshop.
learned: Built to level up my programming and explore what modern web tools can do creatively.

title: Cockroach Janta Party
tagline: An informational site about the CJP movement.
built: A responsive archive site for the Cockroach Janta Party, an internet-born youth movement in India, with official website and petition links. I went for a papery, aesthetic look instead of a typical modern site.
learned: Advanced CSS layouts, responsive design techniques, visual storytelling through UI, and some JavaScript.

title: Tapdish
tagline: A food-ordering web app: tap what you crave, customize it, and pick it up fresh.
built: An online ordering site for a restaurant. It has a full menu across starters, burgers and wraps, pizza and pasta, and Indian mains, with a cart you build as you browse. Made for Pixl's Order Up trial. In progress.

title: EvoGen
tagline: Generational life-sim where inheritance replaces respawning.
built: A generational life-sim in Godot where inheritance replaces respawning: each life passes its traits on, with a few mutations. Try a tiny version of it in the Bloodline demo on the homepage.
